description: Your Downloads folder has 15 miscellaneous files of five types: PDF documents (financial), image files, plain-text notes, media playlist files (.m3u), and other formats (.gpx, .xlsx, .ics). Create ~/Documents/Organized/ with subfolders Financial, Photos, Notes, Media, and Other. Move each file to its matching subfolder. Apply a color Finder tag to each file: Blue for Financial, Yellow for Photos, Green for Notes, Red for Media, Gray for Other. Write a brief Finder comment of at least 5 words on each file describing what it contains. Finally, create ~/Desktop/File_Index.txt with one line per file in the format: filename | folder | comment
